title: hymenochaeta lacustris
intro: Hymenochaeta lacustris, commonly known as the lake fan, is a type of mushroom that belongs to the family Hymenochaetaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hymenochaeta lacustris include its antimicrobial and antioxidant activities, which may help to protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
